comments.author: @tysoncung
comments.text: The thing that surprised me most: France's clocks run from UTC minus ten in French Polynesia to UTC plus twelve in Wallis and Futuna, which is twelve zones, thirteen if you count its Antarctic claim. Russia and the United States each have eleven. Almost none of France's zones are in France. Sources are listed in the description if you want to check the counts, since different lists treat Antarctica differently. What time zone are you in, and is it the same one as the capital of your country?
